verdicts.claim: Specter uniforms, MLK Day 2:30 ET vs 76ers on NBC/Peacock, No. 6 seed 46-36 loss to Knicks, Cup East Group C opener at Boston
verdicts.note: Matches CURRENT FACTS.

summary: We audited eleven dossiers against CURRENT FACTS. Team, schedule and roster claims matched. The real errors were borrowed slang (Trill is Houston, Trill Fam is Baton Rouge) and a mis-dated Pac-Man hawk era. Others: a reversed Dream/Gateway arrangement, wrong Magic City and Paschal's locations, and unsupported colors for the 2020-21 MLK edition. Three live checks confirmed Cascade is operating, moved Paschal's to Castleberry Hill and left Swag Shop unconfirmed. The strategy brief overstates Hawks home Cup Fridays and leans on Wish Atlanta and Swag Shop. Those are logged for the editor.
